arguments.script: var setup=UnityEditor.SceneManagement.EditorSceneManager.GetSceneManagerSetup();try{var sc=UnityEditor.SceneManagement.EditorSceneManager.OpenScene("Assets/Scenes/Level02_Jungle.unity");var m=UnityEngine.Object.FindObjectOfType<UnityEngine.Tilemaps.Tilemap>();var c=m.cellBounds.min;var b=UnityEngine.Object.FindObjectsOfType<UnityEngine.BoxCollider2D>().First(b=>b.name=="Solid row");return "sprite="+m.GetSprite(c).bounds.ToString("F6")+" cell="+m.GetCellCenterWorld(c).ToString("F6")+" type="+m.GetColliderType(c)+" box="+b.bounds.ToString("F6")+" rotation="+b.transform.rotation+" effector="+b.usedByEffector+" parent="+b.transform.parent.name;}finally{UnityEditor.SceneManagement.EditorSceneManager.RestoreSceneManagerSetup(setup);}
